segments.text: Listening Test In the listening test, you will be asked
to demonstrate how well you understand spoken English.
The entire listening test will last approximately 45 minutes.
There are four parts and directions are given for each part.
You must mark your answers on the separate answer sheet.
Do not write your answers in your test book.
Part 1.
Directions For each question in this part, you will
hear four statements about a picture in your test book.
When you hear the statements, you must select the one statement that best describes what
you see in the picture.
Then find the number of the question on your answer sheet and mark your answer.
The statements will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.
Now part 1 will begin.
Number 1.
Look at the picture marked number 1 in your test book.
A.
They're walking along a path.
B. They're cutting the grass.
C. They're swimming in a lake.
D. They're fishing from a dock.
Number 2.
Look at the picture marked number 2 in your test book.
A. Some monitors have been mounted on a wall.
B. Some binders have been left open.
C. Some boxes have been loaded onto a cart.
D. Some chairs have been lined up against a wall.
Number 3.
Look at the picture marked number 3 in your test book.
A. Some cars are lined up along a curb.
B. Some bicycles are parked in a rack.
C. Some bicycles are leaning against a wall.
D. Some crates are stacked near a doorway.
4. Look at the picture marked number 4 in your test book.
A. A customer is carrying a tray of drinks.
B. A customer is reaching for a pastry.
C. A server is leaning over a counter.
D. A server is placing money in a register.
5. Look at the picture marked number 5 in your test book.
A. Some chairs have been stacked against a wall.
B. This box is being sorted.
C. The ladder has been laid on the floor.
D. The table is being folded.
Number 6. Look at the picture marked number 6 in your test book.
A. They're climbing a staircase.
B. They're sitting on a bench.
C. They're crossing a square.
D. They're painting a railing.
Part 2. Directions.
You will hear a question or statement and three responses spoken in English.
They will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.
Select the best response to the question or statement and mark the letter A, B or C on your answer sheet.
Now, let us begin with question number 7.
Number 7.
Who's covering the front desk during the lunch break today?
A. No. Nothing's broken right now.
B. Trevor said he'd take care of it.
C. Over by the pharmacy counter.
Number 8.
We ought to start setting up the banquet tables now.
A.
The delivery hasn't arrived yet.
B. It's a lovely room for events.
C. Those tables seat eight people each.
Number 9.
Which platform does the Bayford train leave from?
A. The next one's in about 10 minutes.
B. Our training sessions are held upstairs.
C.
It goes out from number 5.
Number 10.
I think you should hold off on that article.
A. Twice a month usually.
B. It's already gone to print.
C. Did she hold the door?
Number 11.
Do you want your finished photos delivered as digital files or would you prefer to have them printed?
A.
Yes, they turned out really well.
B. Sometime early next week I hope.
C. The paper ones would be perfect.
Number 12.
Where's the staff awards ceremony being held this year?
A. No.
She hasn't won an award yet.
B. Sometime in the second week of March.
C.
In the main banquet hall downstairs.
Number 13.
How did you manage to clear the whole shipping backlog?
A. By staying a couple of hours late each day.
B. They're already loaded onto the delivery trucks.
C. My back's been a bit sore lately.
Number 14.
When do you need your boots resold by?
A.
Sure, they've all been sold out.
B. By Friday, if you can manage it.
C. The dark brown leather pair.
Number 15.
Where can I watch the penguins being fed?
A. They're fed a mix of small fish.
B. Down by the rocky pool near the entrance.
C. At half past 11 every morning.
Number 16.
I'd like to reserve a couple of lanes for tomorrow evening.
A. That reservoir looks quite low today.
B. The middle lane was blocked earlier.
C. How many players will there be?
Number 17.
Which washer should we service first?
A. Yes, it's been giving us trouble.
B. The one over by the loading dock.
C. A wash cycle costs $3.
Number 18.
I really need to find a dependable house painter.
A. Minded a great job.
B. A soft grey, I think.
C. No, he's a decorator.
Number 19.
You've already got this week's training schedule, don't you?
A. No, I haven't trained anyone yet.
B. Yes, it's up on the board over there.
C. Thanks, that's really thoughtful of you.
Number 20.
What comes with the premium spa package?
A. It's packed almost every afternoon.
B. Over by the changing rooms.
C. You'll get a facial and use of the pool.
Number 21.
How do you usually turn in your monthly report?
A. Please report to the front desk.
B. I upload it to the shared drive.
C. By the last day of the month.
Number 22.
How do I go about reserving one of the private meeting rooms?
A. There's a meeting at noon.
B. The one near the window.
C. Just log in and pick a time.
Number 23.
Is next week's first aid class going to be run in person or online?
A. No, I haven't signed up for it yet.
B. Right after the lunch break, I think.
C. In person, at least this time.
Number 24.
Which printer can I use for these wedding invitations?
A. The one that takes thick paper.
B. Yes, they're all invited.
C. About 200 copies.
Number 25.
I'm surprised the new exercise machines still haven't arrived.
A. Didn't you hear they were delayed?
B. You're welcome to use the treadmill.
C. The tag on the crate.
Number 26.
Who still hasn't signed the equipment logbook?
A. The Mo is working fine now, thanks.
B. I still have to sign mine.
C. Just a couple of extra rakes.
Number 27.
Should we give the new front display to the travel guides or the cookbooks?
A. The cookbooks always sell better up front.
B. Have a great trip and send us a postcard.
C. They're on the second shelf near the entrance.
Number 28.
Would you mind sweeping up around the styling chairs?
A. Those scissors are in the top drawer.
B. The new mirrors look great.
C. Sorry, I'm with the client right now.
Number 29.
Who's going to leave the new guided brewery tours?
A. That hasn't been settled yet.
B. Sure, put my name down for one.
C. They pour pretty generous samples.
Number 30.
Why is my prescription taking so long to fill today?
A. Because our suppliers' delivery was late today.
B. Not until later this afternoon.
C. You can set up automatic refills any time.
Number 31.
Where do you think we should hang this new painting?
A. Sometime next week.
B. I really like the frame on it.
C. Above the reception desk.
Part 3.
Directions. You will hear some conversations between two or more people.
You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speakers say in each conversation.
Select the best response to each question and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet.
The conversations will not be printed in your testbook and will be spoken only one time.
Questions 32-34 refer to the following conversation.
Good morning. Welcome to Bright Brew Cafe. Can I get an order started for you?
A. Oh no, thanks. I'm not ordering today.
I actually came down to let someone know that the coffee machine on the fourth floor is out of order.
It's been making a loud noise all week and now it won't turn on at all.
Thanks for telling me. You're the third person to mention it this morning, so it's clearly a real problem.
I can't fix it from here, but I'll speak to the building's facilities manager right away.
She usually sends someone to look at things like that by the end of the day.
Number 32.
Where most likely does the man work?
Number 33.
Why does the woman come to speak with the man?
Number 34.
What does the man say he will do?
Questions 35-37 refer to the following conversation.
Hi. I'm hoping to skate during one of the open public sessions you run today.
When does the next one begin?
The next one starts at two o'clock and lasts about 90 minutes.
We rent skates right here at the desk, too.
So before I grab you a pair, I'll need to know how big your feet are.
I take a size nine, and yes, I'll definitely need to borrow some. I didn't bring my own.
Perfect. Here's a nine.
The bench over there is the spot to check they fit snugly before you head out onto the ice.
Number 35.
What does the man want to do?
Number 36.
What information does the woman ask the man for?
Number 37.
What will the man most likely do next?
Questions 38-40 refer to the following conversation.
Hi there. Welcome to the workshop. I'm Victor. What can I build for you today?
Hi. I'm opening a small clinic next month, and I need a piece for the front where patients will check in and sign forms.
It should have space for two staff members behind it.
I was thinking light oak. How soon could it be ready?
A reception desk like that usually takes about two weeks once you've approved the design.
It'll go right in the waiting area, so durability matters. Oaks a good call.
Before we get into measurements, come look at these wood samples so you can compare the finishes and settle on a material.
Number 38.
What does the woman want the shop to build?
Number 39.
Where will the piece be placed?
Number 40.
What does the man suggest the woman do next?
Questions 41-43 refer to the following conversation.
Good morning. This is Douglas Reed, one of your regular customers.
My water order was supposed to come today, but it never showed up, and I'm nearly out.
I'm sorry, Mr. Reed. It looks like our driver's route changed this week.
Before I check, could you read me the number printed at the top of your account statement?
Sure, it's 4729. I don't need a refund. I just need the water soon.
I have your record now. Rather than having you reschedule online, I'll send a fresh delivery out first thing tomorrow.
The driver should reach you by nine.
Number 41.
Why is the man calling?
Number 42.
What does the woman ask the man to provide?
Number 43.
What does the woman say she will do?
Questions 44-46 refer to the following conversation.
Hi there. I'm shopping for a new suitcase for my frequent business trips,
and I'd really like one I can wheel through the airport without any effort.
What would you recommend?
Of course, I'm Delia. I'm actually just finishing arranging our new arrivals display right now,
and one of these models would suit you perfectly.
This one, the Voyager Lite, is a spin-a-wheel case that rolls smoothly in every direction,
and is designed to be carry-on approved.
That does look nice. My only worry is whether it'll actually meet the airline size and weight limits,
since I always carry my bag onto the plane instead of checking it.
Number 44.
What type of product is the customer shopping for?
Number 45.
What does the woman say she is currently doing?
Number 46.
What is the man concerned about?
Questions 47-49 refer to the following conversation.
Good morning. Thanks for stopping in. What can we take care of for you today?
Hi. I've got a finished manuscript here, about 300 pages,
and I'd like it made into a proper hardcover volume, with a dark green cloth cover.
Could it be ready before the 20th?
The 20th is no trouble at all, but before we begin production, I'll print out a proof of the cover,
and you'll need to look it over and approve it first.
Number 47.
Where most likely does this conversation take place?
Number 48.
Why most likely is the man at the business?
Number 49.
According to the woman, what must the man do before work begins?
Questions 50-52 refer to the following conversation.
Hi. I'd like to join the Wildmore Brewery tour, if there's still room.
I read about it online last night.
Of course. Another tour is starting in about 10 minutes.
It runs for 45 minutes, and finishes with a tasting of four of our seasonal beers.
That sounds great. I'm also buying gifts for my whole team back at the office.
In that case, our shop sells bottled gift packs.
Each pack holds six of our most popular beers, and they're easy to carry.
Oh, perfect. How much is one pack?
They're $18 each.
The shop is just past the tasting room, on your right.
You can pay there after the tour.
Number 50.
Where most likely are the speakers?
Number 51.
How did the woman learn about the tour?
Number 52.
What does the woman imply when she says,
I'm also buying gifts for my whole team.
Questions 53-55 refer to the following conversation.
Hi. I'm here to pick up the order I placed last week at Fernwood Pharmacy.
I'm leaving on a trip early tomorrow morning, so I wanted to collect everything today.
Of course. Could I have your last name so I can find your order?
Let me check the shelf for you.
Hmm, I see the problem.
Two of your three items are ready, but one of them is currently out of stock.
Oh, no. I really need all of it before I travel.
Is there any way to get it in time?
A new shipment isn't arriving until Thursday, so I can't hand it over today.
But we can send it directly to you.
If you fill out this delivery form with your address, we'll mail it as soon as it arrives.
That works. I'll do that right now. Thanks, Neil.
Number 53.
What is the woman planning to do soon?
Number 54.
What problem does the man mention?
Number 55.
What does the man ask the woman to do?
Questions 56 through 58 refer to the following conversation with three speakers.
The paintings for the new exhibit just arrived. Where do you want us to put them all?
Maybe we could group them by color. The bright ones near the front window.
Actually, this show is organized by year, so we'll hang them from the earliest to the most recent.
Got it. Should we adjust the lighting first or wait until the labels are printed?
Leave the lighting and labels for now.
The main thing is to rearrange these canvases in the right order before the opening tonight.
Sure. Do we start on the left wall as visitors walk in?
Exactly. Line them up along that wall. Oldest first.
Number 56.
Where most likely are the speakers?
Number 57.
What are the speakers mainly discussing?
Number 58.
What does the woman say the men should do?
Questions 59 through 61 refer to the following conversation.
Good afternoon. How can I help you?
Hi. I'm on this evening's flight to Denver, but I need to get in sooner. Can I move to something this afternoon?
Let me check. There's one seat on the two o'clock arriving at four.
A same day change is $40, though on a corporate fair like yours, it's waived once I confirm the code from your travel office.
My assistants sent that approval this morning, so it should be on file.
I have a client presentation downtown at five, and getting into night would be far too late.
You're right. It's here.
I'll update your booking first, then print your new boarding pass.
Number 59.
What is the man trying to do?
Number 60.
What does the man imply when he says getting in tonight would be far too late?
Number 61.
What will the woman most likely do next?
Questions 62 through 64 refer to the following conversation and ticket.
Hi. I'm here to pick up a ticket I ordered online under the name Preston Vale.
Here you are, Mr. Vale.
I should mention that the doors are opening earlier than what's printed on your ticket, now at seven o'clock.
The organizers added an opening performance to the program tonight.
Oh, earlier, I was planning to grab something to eat first.
Will I still have time?
You should be fine, but to make it easy, here's a complimentary voucher for our lobby cafe.
It's good right up until the concert begins.
Number 62.
Look at the graphic.
Which detail on the ticket is now out of date?
Number 63.
Why did the schedule change?
Number 64.
What does the woman give the man besides his ticket?
Questions 65 through 67 refer to the following conversation and map.
Good morning, and welcome to the West Haven Convention Center.
How can I help you today?
Hi there. I'm here to meet with companies that are hiring since I'm looking for a new job.
Could you tell me where that's being held?
Of course. Several events are running today, but the one you want is easy to find.
Just walk straight past the food court in the center, and it's in the hall at the back on the left side.
Watch for the signs above the entrance.
Great. Thank you. Do I need to check in anywhere before I go in?
No, you can walk right in, but I should mention the elevator in that section is out of service today.
So please take the stairs instead.
Good to know. Thanks so much for your help.
Number 65.
Why is the man visiting the convention center?
Number 66.
Look at the graphic. Which hall does the woman direct the man to?
Number 67.
What does the woman caution the man about?
Question 68 through 70 refer to the following conversation and chart.
Hi. I come to Oak Ridge Zoo almost every weekend, and I'm tired of paying for a single ticket each time.
I'd like to become a member. What levels do you offer?
Good choice, Mr. Hale. Here's our rate chart.
Whichever level you pick, every membership lets you bring a companion in at no extra charge.
How much were you hoping to spend?
I'd rather not go over $170, but I want the best level I can get for that. That one looks right.
Number 68.
Why does the man want to become a member?
Number 69.
According to the woman, what does every membership include?
Number 70.
Look at the graphic. Which membership will the man most likely choose?
Part 4.
Directions.
You will hear some talks given by a single speaker.
You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speaker says in each talk.
Select the best response to each question and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet.
The talks will not be printed in your testbook and will be spoken only one time.
Questions 71 through 73 refer to the following announcement.
Good afternoon, passengers, and welcome to the terminal.
I'm pleased to announce that starting Monday, Coastway Transit will introduce a brand new mobile ticketing service
for all travelers.
With this service, you can purchase and store your tickets right on your phone,
which means you'll no longer need to stand in long lines at the ticket counter,
so your waiting times will be much shorter.
At launch, the service will cover every route departing from this terminal,
including our express lines to the coast.
To begin using it, simply download the Coastway app from your usual app store
before you board.
If you need any help getting set up, our staff at the information desk will be glad to assist you.
Safe travels, everyone.
Number 71.
What is the speaker mainly announcing?
Number 72.
According to the speaker, what is one advantage of the service?
Number 73.
What are interested listeners instructed to do?
Question 74 through 76 referred to the following excerpt from a meeting.
Good morning, everyone.
Before we open, could I have all of our sales associates gather near the counter for a moment?
I've got some exciting news.
Our shipment of the new season's products arrived overnight,
and I'd like to point out one item in particular.
We now have the latest running shoes in stock.
They're lightweight, comfortable, and come in several fresh colors.
Honestly, we've had customers asking about them for weeks,
so I expect they'll sell quickly.
That's why I want to feature them right at the front of the store.
Diego, before we open the doors,
could you please set up a display for the running shoes near the entrance?
Thanks, everyone.
Number 74.
Who most likely is the announcement for?
Number 75.
What is one characteristic of the running shoes?
Number 76.
What does the speaker ask Diego to do?
Question 77 through 79 refer to the following excerpt from a meeting.
Good morning, everyone, and thanks for getting here so early.
I know today is going to be busy, so I'll keep this brief.
First, a quick reminder.
Every ride operator and ticket booth staff member must carry a two-way radio at all times while on shift.
That rule stays in place no matter where you're stationed.
Now, one other thing.
This week, our visitor numbers have been much higher than we expected for this time of year,
so when we unlocked the front gate,
I'd like all of you to open the extra ticket booths right away
rather than waiting for the lines to build up.
Thanks again.
Number 77.
Where does the speaker most likely work?
Number 78.
What are employees required to do?
Number 79.
What does the speaker say has happened this week?
Questions 80 through 82 refer to the following telephone message.
Hi, this is Ingrid from Cedar Grove Party Rentals, returning your call about your order for this weekend.
The whole order is packed and our loading areas open Friday any time after two.
One note, the rectangular tables you asked for are out of stock,
so I pulled round ones from inventory instead.
They seat 12 guests each, the same as the ones you ordered.
When you arrive, please count everything against your order form before our staff load your van.
Could you give me a call back to confirm your pickup slot?
Thanks so much.
Number 80.
Why is the speaker calling?
Number 81.
What does the speaker imply when she says they seat 12 guests each, the same as the ones you ordered?
Number 82.
What does the speaker ask the customer to do upon arrival?
Questions 83 through 85 refer to the following broadcast.
Good morning listeners and welcome to this week's Community Bulletin.
This Saturday, the Hartsdale Neighborhood Association, together with the City Parks Department,
is hosting a tree planting volunteer day at Rowan Meadow Park.
After last month's storms delayed our first attempt, we're determined to plant 300 saplings along the park's restored east lawn.
Volunteers should bring a sturdy pair of work gloves, though all the tools, young trees and refreshments will be supplied on site.
To reserve one of our limited spots, please visit our website and register before Thursday evening rather than calling the park office.
We'd love to see you there.
Number 83.
What is the broadcast mainly about?
Number 84.
What are participants asked to bring themselves?
Number 85.
How can interested listeners take part in the event?
Questions 86 through 88 refer to the following excerpt from a meeting.
Good morning everyone and welcome.
I'm pleased to say that at Ashline Bank, our new rewards programme, Bright Circle, launches at the end of this month.
Working with Denise from our regional office, I've been pulling together the reference guides you'll each need to walk customers through it.
The idea is to give our loyal account holders a genuine reason to stay with us rather than switch banks.
As the team agreed at last month's staff meeting, anyone who enrolls will pay less each month in account charges now built into the rollout.
Before then, I'll gather everyone to work through whatever still feels unclear, so please come with your questions.
Number 86.
What is the speaker currently working on?
Number 87.
According to the speaker, what did the staff agree to at a previous meeting?
Number 88.
What does the speaker plan to do before the programme launches?
Questions 89 through 91 refer to the following excerpt from a training session.
Good morning everyone and thanks for coming in before the store opens.
Starting this week, the way we handle refunds at the service desk will look a little different from what you're used to.
We kept getting complaints that the line moved far too slowly and this should finally fix that.
When a customer brings something back, scan their receipt into the register before touching the item.
Do it the other way and the system won't pull up the sale.
And please don't key the product code in by hand.
That's exactly what was slowing everyone down before.
I've left printed instructions on the counter, so grab a copy and keep it in your apron.
Number 89.
What is the main purpose of the talk?
Number 90.
Why is the store changing the refund process?
Number 91.
What does the speaker ask the listeners to do?
Questions 92 through 94 refer to the following telephone message.
Hi, it's Camille from the receiving area here at Meadowgate Plant Nursery.
I'm calling because the shipment of young seedlings we booked for Thursday actually turned up this morning, two days early.
Remember, we'd arranged for the extra weekend crew to come in on Thursday to handle it.
So right now the trays are just sitting out on the loading dock and these plants really need to go into the cool storage room within the hour.
If we leave them in the sun much longer, the roots will dry out and we could lose the whole batch.
Could you check who's on shift and send a couple of people down?
And please call me back here at the nursery when you get this.
Number 92.
Where does the speaker work?
Number 93.
What does the speaker imply when she says we'd arranged for the extra weekend crew to come in on Thursday to handle it?
Number 94.
What is the speaker concerned about?
Questions 95 through 97 refer to the following telephone message and price list.
Hi, this is Colin Reeves from Brightpage Printworks.
Thanks for sending the specs for the brochure as your team needs for next month's sales conference.
I'd go with the tier just below premium.
It gives you the full color finish and the page count you asked for, so it's the best value.
I did consider premium, but your print run is small, so you won't need the extra options it adds.
I've attached our price sheet so you can compare the tiers.
And rather than wait for the proofs to arrive by mail, stop by tomorrow morning to see a printed sample.
Just let me know. Thanks.
Number 95.
What does the customer need the printing for?
Number 96.
Look at the graphic.
How much will the customer most likely pay?
Number 97.
According to the speaker, what can the customer do tomorrow?
Questions 98 through 100 refer to the following announcement and set of designs.
Good morning, everyone.
As you know, Silverleaf Tea Company has spent months perfecting several new recipes,
and next month will finally bring our garden blends collection to market.
Before approving the packaging, we asked a group of regular customers to taste the blends and tell us which label they preferred.
Based on their feedback, we've chosen a design with the leaf illustration across the top,
and the brand name printed in large letters underneath.
Now that the printer has confirmed the final artwork, I'd like the whole team to update our online store listings
using the new product photos and descriptions this week, so everything is ready before the launch.
Thanks for all your hard work.
Number 98.
What does the speaker say the company will do next month?
Number 99.
Look at the graphic.
Which design did the company choose for the new label?
Number 100.
What does the speaker ask the team to do this week?
